notes:
2026-09-16 (card-results lane, follow-up to this same day's own re-triage note below): acted on that note's own flag. Removed the 2 stale self-cast (`{event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'}`)/self-graveyard (`{to:'Graveyard', controller:'you', subject:'self'}`) typeLine-anchored facts directly from synergy.json (hand-edit, not a script regen — these facts were never recognizer-derived and nothing regenerates them). Definition lane's own pool-wide check confirmed this baseline pair has been dropped as convention everywhere else in the pool (cross-checked against restoration-magic/slash-of-light/snow-villiers, all already pair-free); ultima was 1 of only 4 real remaining outliers (the other 3: esper-origins-summon-esper-maduin, zack-fair, memories-returning — the last of which turned out NOT to match this shape, see its own progress.json). `apply-recognizers.mjs`'s own synthetic-fact match-time synthesis (`isNormalInstantOrSorcery`) picks up the equivalent pair automatically at match time now that the hand-authored duplicate is gone, same as every other plain Instant/Sorcery in the pool — no synergy-matching coverage lost. Re-ran `verify-synergy.mjs ultima`: still 0 hard failures, notes unchanged (byte-identical to the pre-edit run — the 3 destroy-all-related facts and the 5 enters/tapForMana bystander notes this file's own prior entry already explains are untouched). Not a content/behavior change (the card's real modeled destroy-all/dies effects are untouched), so `review` stays `"ai"` unchanged, not reset. `textCoverageAudited`/`knownGaps` untouched (unaffected by this specific removal).

2026-09-16 (fin/26-50 re-triage — Ultima's own destroy-all effect explicitly SKIPPED per the live engine-core escalation in flight for a new combinator Filter card-type predicate; everything else on the card re-triaged as instructed): re-verified fresh, 0 hard failures. 5 AI facts remain. 3 (the destroy event, its dies consequence, and the artifact/creature-presence sink) belong to the destroy-all effect itself — out of scope here by design, left for the in-flight escalation. The other 2 (self-cast / self-graveyard baseline pair, typeLine-anchored) look like a stale leftover of an older pool-wide baseline-fact convention: cross-checked against every other card re-triaged this same batch (restoration-magic/slash-of-light/snow-villiers/etc.) — all of them have since DROPPED this exact baseline pair entirely rather than carry it unprovenanced; only ultima/zack-fair/memories-returning still declare it pool-wide (3 of 325 cards). Flagged to the orchestrator/definition lane as a cleanup candidate (drop, to match the now-prevailing convention) rather than a recognizer target — SYNERGY_DESIGN.md frames including this baseline pair at all as a per-card judgment call, not a deterministic rule, so no recognizer for it is planned or appropriate.

2026-09-12: Migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (SYNERGY_DESIGN.md's synergy.json v2 unified schema), continuation of today's fin/1-37 rollout. NOT to be confused with ultima-origin-of-oblivion (fin/2, a Legendary Creature — God) — this is Ultima (fin/38), a plain Sorcery, {3}{W}{W}. Real oracle text (Scryfall-confirmed, data/fin/fin_scryfall.json #38): "Destroy all artifacts and creatures. End the turn. (Exile all spells and abilities from the stack, including this card. The player whose turn it is discards down to their maximum hand size. Damage wears off, and \"this turn\" and \"until end of turn\" effects end.)" — a single continuous line in Scryfall's own oracle_text field (no \n between the two ability sentences and the reminder-text parenthetical for this specific card), so every oracle annotation uses line:0.

Dropped the old v1 id/sourceText/highlight fields and the FOUR controller-split facts (wipe-graveyard-you/opp, wipe-dies-you/opp) and TWO controller-split sink facts (wipe-needs-you/opp) in favor of unconstrained facts with no controller field, mirroring fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own real, identically-motivated collapse (this card's own oracle text also has no controller restriction — the wipe hits both players symmetrically). No presence-shaped SOURCE facts (per the standing rule) — self-cast ({event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'}) and self-graveyard ({to:'Graveyard', controller:'you', subject:'self'}) mirror fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own self-cast/self-graveyard pair exactly (both typeLine-anchored on 'Sorcery', CR 608.2m).

'Destroy all artifacts and creatures' — a real UNCONDITIONAL, UNTARGETED (no 'target' at all — a real broadcast to every artifact/creature on the battlefield, CR 701.6) mass-destroy, genuinely different in kind from fate-of-the-sun-cryst's/summon-bahamut's own single/up-to-one TARGETED destroy. Modeled as the ACT-vs-CONSEQUENCE pair the design doc's standing rule calls for: destroy-act ({event:'destroy', target:{types:{hasAny:['Artifact','Creature']}}, targeted:false}) stays a bare ACT tag with no inline zoneFrom/zoneTo (CR 701.6 — indestructible/regeneration/protection can still save an individual permanent even inside a mass, unconditional wipe; the movement is conditional PER-PERMANENT even though the effect itself has no target to fizzle), plus a separate dies CONSEQUENCE ({event:'dies', from:'Battlefield', to:'Graveyard', target:{types:{hasAny:['Artifact','Creature']}}, targeted:false}) which DOES carry from/to inline (by the time a permanent actually dies, CR 700.4's battlefield->graveyard move is unconditionally guaranteed, same reasoning as every other dies-consequence fact in the pool). Neither carries subject (the things dying are a type-constrained bucket, not this card itself) or controller (no controller restriction in the real text). New sink fact ({to:'Battlefield', types:{hasAny:['Artifact','Creature']}}, no controller) mirrors fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own unconstrained-sink collapse — 'needs a real artifact or creature present on either side to actually destroy anything.'

'End the turn' — grepped turn.ts/engine.ts/state.ts/card.ts's own Actions interface for endTurn/Time Stop/cleanup-jump machinery before concluding anything: turn.ts's own PHASES/advancePhase only ever advance ONE step at a time in fixed order (no way for a card effect to jump straight to Cleanup), there is no Stack-exile primitive anywhere (the Stack is deliberately never modeled as an assignable zone value at all, per SYNERGY_DESIGN.md's own standing rule), and Cleanup's own real discard-to-maximum-hand-size (turn.ts line ~113) only ever fires as that phase's own automatic action, never as something a card effect can invoke directly mid-turn. Confirmed a genuine, honest documented engine gap — same 'real text only, no possible backing' treatment as Auron's Inspiration's broadcast pump — NOT modeled as a Fact (no engine execution exists to point at as evidence, and inventing one would fabricate trace evidence that can't exist). definition.ts's own pre-existing 'end the turn' custom Effect (a real no-op, already correctly documented before this task) is UNCHANGED — this task confirmed its reasoning is still accurate rather than needing a fix.

scenarios.ts migrated to the engine-trace pilot format (runEngineScenarios) — ONE real scenario (per the new 2026-09-12 standing default), a genuinely SYMMETRIC board: your own real Dragoon's Lance (Artifact) + Dwarven Castle Guard (Creature) + a Plains, and the opponent's own real Phoenix Down (Artifact) + Coeurl (Creature, same non-token permanent fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own scenario already uses) + a Plains. All 4 artifacts/creatures are real, non-token permanents (a token would log ceasesToExist instead of destroy, which can't back a real event:'destroy' ACT fact as trace evidence — same reasoning fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own scenario documents). Real trace confirms: 4 real fn:'destroy' lines (2 controller:'you', 2 controller:'opp0'), both real Plains untouched. 'End the turn' is not and cannot be exercised (no machinery).

Added 'ultima' to ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS (scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs) and wrote annotations-authoring.json (5 facts). compute-annotations.mjs: 5 facts annotated (2 typeLine 'Sorcery' at 0-7, 3 oracle at line 0). compute-weights.mjs --slug=ultima: self-cast/self-graveyard/destroy-act -> value 1 (neutral, no measurable magnitude beyond one occurrence), dies -> value 5 (magnitude 4 real destroy/sacrifice count from the trace, bucketed). verify-synergy.mjs (scoped ultima: 0 hard failures, expected soft notes only — 4 bystander 'enters' + 5 'tapForMana'; full pool 315 v2 cards: 12 pre-existing hard failures, ALL on OTHER cards currently mid-edit by concurrent sibling sessions on this same fin/1-37 rollout, confirmed via git status showing those exact files as uncommitted-modified — none caused by or related to this task's own changes). npx vitest run functional-model: 238/238 (unchanged). annotation-coverage.test.ts: 5/5. scenario-card-names.mjs: 0 violations (all real Scryfall names).

Real find-synergies.mjs diff, isolated via an old(v1)/new(v2) synergy.json swap (not a stale git-HEAD diff — the pool has many other concurrent uncommitted migrations in flight from sibling sessions right now, confirmed via git status, so a HEAD-based diff couldn't isolate just this card's own change): 34 old lines -> 22 new lines for this card's own edges (net -12, fully accounted for, no surprises):
- Lost 9 duplicate 'graveyard presence' lines (the old wipe-graveyard-you controller='you' fact was fully redundant with self-graveyard — both unconstrained, controller='you' — collapsing them removes double-counting the SAME 9 real cards self-graveyard already matches once; wipe-graveyard-opp/controller='opp' matched 0 real cards in the old file, so no loss there).
- Lost 12 real EventFact-shaped 'dying' lines (Aerith Gainsborough, Dwarven Castle Guard, Judge Magister Gabranth x2, Magic Pot, Sephiroth Fabled SOLDIER x2, Sephiroth Planet's Heir, Undercity Dire Rat, Vincent Valentine, Zodiark Umbral God x2) — the old wipe-dies-you/opp facts were pure EventFacts (no zone data); the new merged dies fact carries real from/to, so per the pool's own standing 'a merged fact classifies zone-shaped ONLY' rule (SYNERGY_DESIGN.md, summon-bahamut precedent) it no longer satisfies these real event-shaped sinks. Same accepted, already-precedented shape-family regression, not a new one.
- Gained 9 real zone-shaped Graveyard-presence lines (Cantankerous Keepers, Eden Seat of the Sanctum, Emet-Selch Unsundered, Ignis Scientia, Magic Pot, Qutrub Forayer, Rydia's Return, Thranduil Sindarin Liege, Vanille Cheerful l'Cie) — the EXACT SAME 9 cards named in summon-bahamut's own SYNERGY_DESIGN.md writeup as the real unconstrained zone-shaped sinks a merged dies fact newly reaches; confirms the new dies fact's from/to data is doing real, correctly-classified work.
- Sink side (this card's own want for battlefield artifact/creature presence): 0 net change — the old two controller-split sink facts and the new single unconstrained one already matched the identical real producer set pool-wide, same as fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own sink collapse.
- self-cast (genuinely NEW fact, didn't exist in v1 at all): 0 new matches — no pool sink wants a bare 'cast a spell' from a Sorcery, and no self-interaction triggers (unlike summon-bahamut's cast/enters pair, this card has no other fact shaped to self-interact with it).

2026-09-16 (engine lane) — built real 'end the turn' turn-ending machinery for real, closing the engine gap this file's own prior note above had documented as genuinely absent. Re-derived the gap independently first (grepped turn.ts/engine.ts/state.ts/stack.ts/card.ts's Actions interface myself rather than trusting the prior note) and confirmed it: PHASES/advancePhase only ever step one phase at a time, no Stack-exile primitive existed, Cleanup's own discard-to-max-hand-size only ever fired as that phase's own automatic action. Checked real Forge (tmp/mtg-forge) for the real architecture: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/ability/effects/EndTurnEffect.java's own resolve() does 4 real steps — (1) exile everything on the stack including itself (Gatherer's own Time Stop ruling: 'This includes Time Stop, though it will continue to resolve'), (2) end combat, (3) check state-based actions, (4) PhaseHandler.endTurnByEffect() — a DIRECT setPhase(CLEANUP)+onPhaseBegin() jump, not a walk through every intervening phase. This confirmed the task's own hypothesis: a narrow, dedicated primitive (not a full turn-structure rework) was the right scope. Built: turn.ts's new jumpToCleanup() (direct phaseIndex jump to Cleanup + runs its existing runPhaseEntryAction, so discard/damage-clear/UEOT-clear/etc. are the exact same real Cleanup code every natural Cleanup entry already uses, never duplicated); stack.ts's new Stack.exileAll() (drains every remaining stack item at once); engine.ts's new endTurn(engine) (exileAll + move each drained real card to Exile + end combat + checkStateBasedActions + jumpToCleanup); card.ts's new Effect kind 'endTurn' (bare, no fields) wired through a genuinely new Actions.endTurn (interfaces.ts's own ambient endTurn() declaration, full EndTurnEffect.java citation in its doc comment) and a new EffectContext.selfToExile field (set by applyEffect's own case 'endTurn', read back by engine.ts's resolveTop wrapper — real 721.1a 'including this card' ruling: the resolving spell itself goes to Exile, not the graveyard, additive to the pre-existing thenExile/Flashback check). engine-trace.ts's pilotActions gained a real endTurn override (mirrors queueExtraPhase's own real-vs-log-only split) that calls the real engine.ts function then reconstructs Cleanup's own real discard/UEOT-removal log entries via the SAME logAutomaticPhaseEntry helper advanceOneStep already uses, so the trace shows genuinely-diffed real state changes, not an asserted claim; also fixed pilotResolveTop's own to:'Exile'/'Graveyard' computation to read peeked.ctx.selfToExile AFTER calling resolveTop (it's only set DURING that call) rather than before, and threaded the same ctx.selfToExile check into harness.ts's own lifecycleAfter (flat-scenario path) for completeness, even though no card exercises it via that path today. definition.ts's own second effect is now kind:'endTurn' (was kind:'custom', run:()=>{}). scenarios.ts's own scenario now demonstrates 3 of this ability's real sub-effects for real: stocked your own hand with 9 real Forest (harness.ts's own precedented GENERIC_FILLER_LAND handCount convention, not an invented placeholder) so Cleanup's own discard genuinely fires (qty:2, 9->7); confirmed via trace.json a real discard entry, a real move Ultima ... to:'Exile' entry (not Graveyard), and a real phase:'Cleanup' entry. The 4th real sub-effect (exiling OTHER spells/abilities still on the stack) is legally UNREACHABLE for this specific card and was NOT force-fit into the scenario: Ultima is a plain Sorcery, which CR 307.1a/117.1a only allows to be CAST when the stack is already empty — by strict LIFO resolution, anything added in response goes on top and must fully resolve before Ultima's own turn to resolve ever comes around, so nothing can legally still be pending underneath it at that moment. Stack.exileAll()/engine.ts's endTurn() are still built to the real, general shape (a future instant-speed 'end the turn' FIN card, should one exist, could actually exercise that sub-case) — verified this reasoning holds by inspection of canCastSpell's own sorcery-speed gate, not asserted. Verified end-to-end: npx tsc --noEmit clean; npx vitest run functional-model 98/98 files, 951 passed/5 skipped; full-repo npx vitest run — 1 pre-existing, unrelated failure file (scripts/relations.test.mjs, 5 tests, missing tagging/sets/{lea,leb,2ed,arn}_relations.json + tagging/card-enrichment-status.json — confirmed unrelated to this task, never touched by it); scoped verify-synergy.mjs ultima — 0 hard failures (same pre-existing 4 enters+5 tapForMana soft notes, PLUS 2 new expected soft notes: 'unrecognized action endTurn' and the new move-to-Exile entry, both accepted no-fact-vocabulary notes, not failures); full-pool verify-synergy.mjs — 320 v2 cards checked, 5 skipped, 0 hard failures (no regression anywhere else in the pool). Fact/synergy vocabulary for the endTurn event itself was deliberately NOT added (see knownGaps below) — this task's own scope was the engine primitive, not new pool-wide synergy vocabulary; `verifySynergy` stays 'notes' (soft notes only, same as before), `review` stays 'ai' (this IS a real authored-content/behavior change — definition.ts's own effect kind changed — so review is correctly NOT silently left at a stale value; it was already 'ai' before this task, unchanged).
knownGaps: "End the turn" now has real engine machinery (closed 2026-09-16, see this file's own dated note above) but still carries no synergy Fact/vocabulary of its own — the forced discard/stack-exile/damage-clear this ability performs are downside "wash" mechanics no real FIN pool card's own sink vocabulary wants to match against, same category as `tapForMana`'s own deliberately-unmodeled status; not attempted here, flagged for the card/recognizer lane if a real use ever surfaces.
